prompt: RimWorld terrain tile, seen straight down: one cell of the swale, a hand-graded seep canal. The cell is filled edge to edge by a flat channel of brown-clear, faintly red-tinged water with a gentle diagonal ripple, set flush into the ground. A thin inset lip of fitted stone and packed clay runs along the two long edges, pierced by small dark weep-holes, and just beyond each lip a narrow darker, moss-green seep line where the water feeds the bank. No walls standing up, no cast shadow, no rounded banks, no object centred on a background. The tile must repeat seamlessly left-right and top-bottom.
